answer: Concrete sybil resistance via walnut anchoring: each agent must lock a walnut stake of 18,000 POA for 20 epochs; the stake erodes 5% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A dawn of 15 rotating auditors samples each epoch's output; divergent outputs trigger a 30% stake burn. At the nadir of each epoch, validators are resampled from the top 45 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 18,000N POA for 20 epochs and survive 15 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
